units: Shebi. VIII, 6 אין … בַּבַּד you must not press olives in the tank (in the Sabbath year).—בית הַבַּד the building containing the tank and all implements for pressing olives.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:9">Sabb. I, 9</cite> <he>קורת ב׳ הב׳</he> the beam of the press; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Beitzah 19a">Bets. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Beitsah 2:7">Tosef. ib. II, 7</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00031"><he>גַּב</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>בַּדִּים</he>, <cite ref="B00144"><he>בַּדִּין</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:7">B. Bath. IV, 7</cite> <he>בית הב׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 9:7">Toh. IX, 7</cite> <he>בד אחד או שני ב׳</he> a quantity of olives for one tank or for two; a. fr.
